findings.quote: Parents and children can book back to back.
findings.why: The ficha says parents and children can "often" book back to back (and the FAQ answers "Often, yes"), so dropping "often" promises same-day availability more firmly than the clinic does.
findings.fix: Change to "Parents and children can often book back to back."

suggestions.quote: If you are looking for family checkups and cleanings in Austin, you can read more on our
suggestions.why: This sentence reads as keyword-stuffed SEO filler, and the first-visit child price that follows is out of place in an article about adults.
suggestions.fix: Rewrite it naturally, for example "Read more about our family checkups and cleanings," and move or drop the child price.

suggestions.quote: The emergency exam at Copper Wren Dental Studio is $85.
suggestions.why: The ficha adds that any treatment is quoted after the exam, and the post leaves this out.
suggestions.fix: Add "Any treatment is quoted after the exam."

suggestions.why: The FAQ section repeats, almost word for word, the body sections on same-day booking and insurance, which feels templated and padded.
suggestions.fix: Remove the duplicated body sections or vary the FAQ wording so the page doesn't repeat itself.
